proposed_from.topic: Support-adaptive uniform joint inference for the accepted survivor-complier sharp benefit interval. Keep the accepted parent's finite-X, finite-ordered-Y binary-IV model and exact endpoint map Phi=(L,U), assume only instrument overlap and aggregate survivor mass M>=m_*>0, and allow individual survivor cells and threshold gaps to vanish arbitrarily. Construct the explicit nearby-legal-base directional envelope T_n and its common-Gaussian max-norm rectangle C_n. Prove uniform joint 1-alpha coverage over all triangular arrays, exact oracle Gaussian calibration on separated regular faces, and O_P(n^-1/2) width along root-n emerging-support and tied-cut arrays. The hard kernel is the legal observed-law inner-neighborhood comparison and relative critical-value transfer when endpoint variance vanishes; pointwise bootstrap validity, endpoint-wise Bonferroni, or the parent's deterministic guard cannot substitute. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: the presolve derived the finite unconditional-capacity reduction, regular-face oracle calibration, uniformly tight critical values, and a multinomial Gaussian coupling. It verified a legal K=4 two-cell array with upper cuts (.40,.30,.30,.40), M_n=.25+.25/sqrt(n), exact upper endpoint (.8+.4/sqrt(n))/(1+1/sqrt(n)), and centered limit N(0,1.28); a Poisson rare-outcome counterexample attempt was conservatively covered by endogenous nearby-base padding. These calculations separate root-n deterministic drift from sampling fluctuation and correctly type projection on contrast masses rather than atom vectors. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: prove the deterministic inner-neighborhood comparison LC, especially legal-law realization of capacity derivative domination and relative quantile validity when the envelope scale vanishes. EARLY KILL TEST: certify legal-face maximization on K=4 two-cell arrays combining root-n survivor emergence, lambda/n rare atoms, simultaneous ties, and a degenerate endpoint limit for a_n=n^-1/3 and n^-0.49; a controlled coverage deficit or persistent legal-versus-ambient mismatch stops the run. Kaido, Molinari, and Stoye (2022) and Voronin (2025) identify why geometry and unrestricted uniformity cannot be assumed.","consumer_value":"The result supplies an honest, root-\\(n\\)-width joint report for an already sharp survivor-complier benefit interval in studies where rare strata and near-tied ordinal cuts are empirically unavoidable.","non_subsumption":"The accepted parent supplies the endpoint formula but not the unguarded uniform rectangle. Fang and Santos require consistent derivative estimation at the target law; Frandsen and Pond and Imai and Okamoto begin with regular endpoint representations, with Imai and Okamoto also imposing variance bounded away from zero; Andrews and Guggenberger standardize supplied moment statistics with positive component variances; Hong and Li use convex Lipschitz structure; Voronin's unrestricted impossibility does not preclude a model-specific legal envelope; Gaussian-max results control additive approximation or retain a nonvanishing scale. The selected kernel changes the first inferential proof step by realizing analytic capacity faces inside the causal observed-law image and changes the last step by transferring critical values relatively at a collapsing scale.","precise_gap":"No located result constructs a shrinking neighborhood of legal binary-instrument observed laws, takes the supremum of the exact imported survivor-capacity endpoint derivative over that neighborhood, and proves joint coverage uniformly when cells, threshold gaps, and the entire Gaussian envelope scale may vanish."}
